name: Iochi Mizuki
source:
[i]"I don't know. It could be a bad prank. Either way, the cuplrit is, well... It's probably that creepy man."[/i]

The oldest of the cast members. Unlike their appearance, they're pretty bold, often acting as the host of the disorderly group. 

[From [url=http://ideafintl.com/charade-maniacs/chara/?page=ch9]Idea Factory International[/url]]
